subtitulo: Se vio rodeado de cámaras. Nos vimos obligados a salir.
regla: Verse + participle (agreeing) describes a state someone ends up in, usually positive or negative for them: se vio rodeado, nos vimos obligados, te verás beneficiada. Like a passive, but focused on how it affects the person.

bloques.texto: It means _to find oneself, to end up, to be_ + participle, with a **result that affects the person**, for better or worse.
Very common: **verse obligado a** (_to be forced to_).
The participle agrees with the person: **se vieron obligadas**.
Tip: **verse** = you look up and suddenly you're there.

lista.es: ==Se vio rodeado== de cámaras y le entró el pánico.
lista.en: He found himself surrounded by cameras and panicked.

lista.es: ==Nos vimos humillados== y decidimos salir de la junta.
lista.en: We felt humiliated and decided to leave the meeting.

lista.es: No te preocupes, Raquel, ==te vas a ver beneficiada== con el nuevo contrato.
lista.en: Don't worry, Raquel, you'll benefit from the new contract.

lista.es: Los alumnos ==se ven frustrados== por la desorganización de la escuela.
lista.en: The students are frustrated by the school's disorganization.

lista.es: ==Se está viendo manipulado== por su novia y no sabe qué hacer.
lista.en: He's being manipulated by his girlfriend and doesn't know what to do.

lista.es: ==Nos vimos obligados== a cancelar el viaje.
lista.en: We were forced to cancel the trip.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _We were forced to sell the house._
lista.r: Nos vimos obligados a vender la casa.

lista.p: In Spanish: _They'll be affected by the change._
lista.r: Se van a ver afectados por el cambio.
